snippet.title: Cuphead Wii U | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
A full copy of Cuphead is required for the game to run, more info on the itch.io page.

This is a complete fully working port made by The Latte Team and PatnosD for the Wii U, enjoy!

DOWNLOAD LINK: https://thelatteteam.itch.io/cuphead-wii-u

Cuphead is a classic run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Inspired by cartoons of the 1930s, the visuals and audio are painstakingly created with the same techniques of the era, i.e. traditional hand drawn cel animation, watercolor backgrounds, and original jazz recordings.
Play as Cuphead or Mugman (in local co-op) as you traverse strange worlds, acquire new weapons, learn powerful super moves, and discover hidden secrets while you try to pay your debt back to the devil. 

We do not recommend playing it in Cemu as it may crash and is overall pretty unstable!

If there's any bug, please report it to our discord server:
https://discord.gg/EUn4pGy5gc
